research_notes: The relay's target metric should ultimately include successful continuation, because a long turn with no usable successor is operationally poor.
Start pre-arm substantially decouples continuation from late-turn close but does not eliminate wake jitter.
Gap optimization will therefore need actual next-start measurements after runtime cap validation.
Intentional overlap may later turn some would-be idle gap into useful shadow/parallel work, but only with fencing.
The current ordering—runtime envelope, cap validation, policy, then parallel optimization—is methodologically cleaner.
No evidence from this strict sample should be used to prematurely resume parallel mode.
